args.summary: Latest deploy v2.3.1 caused checkout-api to fail health checks with an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Per runbook, rolled back in all production regions to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east); a retry completed the rollout to us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback verification: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down to 0.2%. v2.3.1 remains unreleased and should not be redeployed until root cause is identified.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after failed health checks

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis**
- `checkout-api` was on **v2.3.1** across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an **18% error rate**.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy; v2.3.1-rc was only staging).

**Rollback**
- Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east); a retry completed the rollout to us-west and eu-west.
- Post-rollback verification: all regions on v2.3.0, service **healthy**, error rate down to **0.2%**.

**Incident**
- The incident creation call timed out, but re-checking confirmed it was actually created: **INC-0001 (SEV2, open)** — "checkout-api rolled back from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after failed health checks" — with full details of the failure, the partial-failure retry, and verification results.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.

transcript.reasoning_content: Partial failure — us-west and eu-west may not have been rolled back. Check status.

transcript.content: The rollback partially succeeded — us-east is on v2.3.0, but us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. Retrying the rollback to complete it in the remaining regions.
transcript.reasoning_content: us-east rolled back to v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1. Retry rollback (the tool should handle all regions; retrying is the intended recovery).

transcript.content: All regions are now on v2.3.0. Let me verify the service is healthy again.
Service is healthy again. Now opening the SEV2 incident.
